status: HELD — idea recorded 2026-07-27, not cast; berths on inference_domain's yield_report when cast
the_idea:
AKIEN, VERBATIM: 'right now we track cost for the inference sources. using open router prices, we should show our inference cost for hex in negative numbers. because basically, it's paying itself off.' And, same conversation: 'every time we use it instead of the cloud, we saved that amount, and can appy it against the purchase price.'

---- SEAM: everything below is CC's read. ----

HIS SECOND LINE NAMES THE LEDGER: an amortization account. Each Hex-served call books a credit (the cloud price it displaced) against a fixed debit (the M1's purchase price); the meter's headline is the remaining balance and the date it is projected/observed to cross zero.

A VALUATION LAYER over the meter that already exists: yield_report counts real tokens on every call (host.py chose /api/embed over the counter-less endpoint for exactly this). The idea prices those tokens against the OpenRouter sheet for the comparable model and SIGNS Hex-served calls NEGATIVE — every local inference is earnings against the M1's purchase price. The cumulative curve crossing the hardware cost turns 'Hex has paid itself off' from a vibe into a DATED, MEASURABLE EVENT (Law 3).
honesty_seams: THE NEGATIVE NUMBER IS A COUNTERFACTUAL AND SAYS SO: no money moved — it is avoided-cost priced against an external sheet. The record of truth stores what is measured (real token counts) plus a provenance-dated price-sheet snapshot; the dollar figure is a DERIVED VIEW recomputed on read, never a stored row (derive-don't-store; a compiled view is never hand-edited).

THE PRICE SHEET DRIFTS: refresh when stale ON READ (event, not poll — no clock fetches OpenRouter); every rendered dollar carries its sheet's date. A payback claim priced on a stale sheet is labeled as such, not silently wrong.

THREE TIERS, NOT TWO — the best part: cloud call = positive dollars; Hex call = negative (vs the cloud counterfactual); cache HIT = avoids even the local cost, and avoided-tokens already meters that. The meter renders the whole compilation gradient — as things settle the number gets MORE negative. The accounting incentive points the same direction as Law 1: the cheapest call is the one never made.
berth_when_cast: inference_domain — this is a presentation layer over yield_report, not a new component. Needs: a price-sheet snapshot with date + source, the comparable-model mapping (qwen2.5:7b, nomic-embed-text -> their OpenRouter listings), the signed derivation on read, and the hardware-price constant the cumulative curve is measured against.
